verse.verse_1: By those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the disbelievers and the wicked) with great violence;
verse.verse_2: By those (angels) who gently take out (the souls of the believers);
verse.verse_3: And by those that swim along (i.e. angels or planets in their orbits, etc.).
verse.verse_4: And by those that press forward as in a race (i.e. the angels or stars or the horses, etc.).
verse.verse_5: And by those angels who arrange to do the Commands of their Lord, (so verily, you disbelievers will be called to account).
verse.verse_6: On the Day (when the first blowing of the Trumpet is blown), the earth and the mountains will shake violently (and everybody will die),
verse.verse_7: The second blowing of the Trumpet follows it (and everybody will be raised up),
verse.verse_8: (Some) hearts that Day will shake with fear and anxiety.
verse.verse_10: They say: "Shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state of life?
verse.verse_12: They say: "It would in that case, be a return with loss!"
verse.verse_13: But only, it will be a single Zajrah [shout (i.e., the second blowing of the Trumpet)]. (See Verse 37:19).
verse.verse_14: When, behold, they find themselves over the earth alive after their death,
verse.verse_15: Has there come to you the story of Musa (Moses)?
verse.verse_16: When his Lord called him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
verse.verse_17: Go to Fir'aun (Pharaoh), verily, he has transgressed all bounds (in crimes, sins, polytheism, disbelief, etc.).
verse.verse_18: And say to him: "Would you purify yourself (from the sin of disbelief by becoming a believer)",
verse.verse_19: And that I guide you to your Lord, so you should fear Him?
verse.verse_20: Then [Musa (Moses)] showed him the great sign (miracles).
verse.verse_22: Then he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).
verse.verse_23: Then he gathered his people and cried aloud,
verse.verse_24: Saying: "I am your lord, most high",
verse.verse_25: So Allah, seized him with punishment for his last [i.e. his saying: "I am your lord, most high") (see Verse 79:24)] and first [(i.e. his saying, "O chiefs! I know not that you have a god other than I" (see Verse 28:38)] transgression.
verse.verse_26: Verily, in this is an instructive admonition for whosoever fears Allah.
verse.verse_27: Are you more difficult to create, or is the heaven that He constructed?
verse.verse_28: He raised its height, and He has equally ordered it,
verse.verse_29: Its night He covers with darkness, and its forenoon He brings out (with light).
verse.verse_30: And after that He spread the earth;
verse.verse_31: And brought forth therefrom its water and its pasture;
verse.verse_32: And the mountains He has fixed firmly;
verse.verse_33: (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.
verse.verse_34: But when there comes the greatest catastrophe (i.e. the Day of Recompense, etc.),
verse.verse_35: The Day when man shall remember what he strove for,
verse.verse_36: And Hell-fire shall be made apparent in full view for (every) one who sees,
verse.verse_37: Then, for him who Tagha (transgressed all bounds, in disbelief, oppression and evil deeds of disobedience to Allah).
verse.verse_38: And preferred the life of this world (by following his evil desires and lusts),
verse.verse_39: Verily, his abode will be Hell-fire;
verse.verse_40: But as for him who feared standing before his Lord, and restrained himself from impure evil desires, and lusts.
verse.verse_41: Verily, Paradise will be his abode.
verse.verse_42: They ask you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) about the Hour, - when will be its appointed time?
verse.verse_43: You have no knowledge to say anything about it,
verse.verse_44: To your Lord belongs (the knowledge of) the term thereof?
verse.verse_45: You (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) are only a warner for those who fear it,
verse.verse_46: The Day they see it, (it will be) as if they had not tarried (in this world) except an afternoon or a morning.
